BiblicalUsage: Sâphâm is the word for the beard (as a lippiece). It stands in 2 Samuel 19:24, "…neither dressed his feet, nor trimmed his beard…", and in Ezekiel 24:17, "…cry, make no mourning for the dead, bind…".
TheologicalSignificance: I believe sâphâm is worth knowing, because nothing in Scripture is there by accident.
Sources: Strong's Exhaustive Concordance (1890), via OpenScriptures Strong's Dictionary (CC BY-SA)
